strings.name: Bjarke Ingels
strings.summary: Ingels trained in Denmark and Spain, worked at OMA and co-founded PLOT with Julien de Smedt before establishing BIG as an independent company. His housing, public facilities and urban projects combine uses and connect environmental goals with everyday experience. 8 House, VIA 57 West and CopenHill were realized by teams and engineering collaborators. Exhibitions, publications and international teaching also disseminate his practice.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones verifiable through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Through mixed-use buildings and urban projects, he combines sustainability goals with everyday use, influencing international communication about architecture and urban design.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied at the Royal Danish Academy’s architecture school and Barcelona’s ETSAB; completed architectural studies in 1999.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Combining building uses
strings.highlights.h1.text: The team combines housing, commerce and public activities to explore different organizations of urban space.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Environment and experience
strings.highlights.h2.text: CopenHill combines waste-to-energy infrastructure with rooftop skiing and other activities, expressing his design approach.
strings.timeline.t1.title: CopenHill opens
strings.timeline.t1.text: The team’s Copenhagen energy facility opened, combining industrial architecture with leisure activities.
strings.timeline.t2.title: VIA 57 West completed
strings.timeline.t2.text: The New York housing project combines a courtyard with a high-rise form, expanding BIG’s American practice.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Superkilen park
strings.timeline.t3.text: With collaborators, completed a Copenhagen public space using diverse urban objects to express community connections.
strings.timeline.t4.title: 8 House completed
strings.timeline.t4.text: Connected housing and commercial spaces in Copenhagen with a continuous path, exploring a mixed-use community.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Mountain Dwellings completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: The team combined parking with stepped housing, providing residents with terrace space.
strings.timeline.t6.title: BIG becomes independent
strings.timeline.t6.text: After PLOT dissolved, established BIG as a separate company, continuing collaborative design practice.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds PLOT
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established a practice with Julien de Smedt; both had previously worked at OMA.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes architectural studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Finished architectural training in Denmark and Spain, laying foundations for international practice.
